name: Duplicati
description: A backup client with a web interface: encrypted, deduplicated, scheduled backups to S3, B2, SFTP, WebDAV, OneDrive, Google Drive and many other destinations. It can only back up what is inside its own container — this template mounts no host directories — so it is for data on volumes attached to it, with a local destination volume as a second copy.

access.note: Duplicati's web interface has one password and no account name: the generated value from the Variables tab is the whole credential. It is applied on every start, so rotating it here changes the sign-in. The interface only answers to this deployment's domain and to IP addresses; another hostname needs adding to DUPLICATI__WEBSERVICE_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Duplicati refuses requests for hostnames it was not told about, so the address it is opened at has to be named here.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The web interface and its API

volumes.name: config
volumes.purpose: Duplicati's settings database: backup definitions, schedules, credentials and local block databases

volumes.name: backups
volumes.purpose: A local destination for backup sets, when a remote one is not the only copy wanted

update.notes: Duplicati upgrades its settings database on start. Keep the settings encryption key with the backup of the config volume: the stored destination credentials cannot be read without it.

secrets.name: web-password
secrets.label: Web interface password
secrets.description: Reveal it from the Variables tab; it is the whole sign-in.

secrets.name: settings-encryption-key
secrets.label: Settings encryption key
secrets.description: Encrypts the destination credentials stored in the settings database.
